credit_line: Purchase, Mr. and Mrs. Milton Petrie Gift, 1981
description: The right side of the composition features the red and pink form of a seated, nude woman with pinned-up dark brown hair. Her form contrasts with a bright blue background. The work is loosely painted and has few details.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
